pictures.name: PT1-Grief-Road
pictures.prompt: A lonely dirt road through ancient Indian countryside under a grey-blue evening sky after rain. Patacara (a young Indian woman of about twenty-five, long dark tangled hair, a plain undyed cotton shawl wrapped around her, a face worn by grief) walks slowly alone in the middle of the road, eyes far away, the shawl slipping from her shoulders. No other people, no injury, gentle and sorrowful. Blue shadows, a thin line of gold light on the horizon.
